violet.comment: THE brand colour, chosen from The Modern Standard board. One colour, used decisively. 6.76:1 on white so it is safe for text and for solid buttons carrying white. Do NOT use it on dark - 2.91:1 on ink; use violet-bright there.

violet-bright.comment: The brand colour ON DARK. DERIVED, not a second brand colour. 5.28:1 on ink and 4.79:1 on panel, but only 3.72:1 on white - never text on a light surface.

violet-deep.comment: Hover and pressed states for solid violet controls on light. 9.50:1 with white. DERIVED.

ink.comment: Near-black, from the chosen board. Body text on light surfaces at 19.64:1, and the deepest dark surface.

canvas.comment: The dark product page background. DERIVED from ink.

panel.comment: Dark cards and panels, one step up from canvas so elevation reads without a shadow. DERIVED. White on it is 17.82:1.

surface.comment: The marketing site's page surface. The site is light and the product is dark - a deliberate split, not an inconsistency.

surface-subtle.comment: Alternating light sections. DERIVED: violet tinted a few percent over white so it stays in the brand's temperature rather than going grey.

white.comment: Text and surfaces on dark blocks. Same value as surface; kept as a separate role so intent is readable in templates.

muted.comment: Secondary text on light surfaces. 6.57:1 on white.

muted-dark.comment: Secondary text on dark surfaces. 7.09:1 on ink. Never on white - 2.77:1.

status-ok.comment: Healthy, on LIGHT surfaces. 5.42:1 on white. STATUS ONLY - never decorative, or the meaning erodes.

status-ok-dark.comment: Healthy, ON DARK. From the identity sheet. 5.62:1 on near-black. Only 3.49:1 on white - never use on the light site.

status-warn.comment: Attention, on LIGHT surfaces. 6.17:1 on white. STATUS ONLY.

status-warn-dark.comment: Attention, ON DARK. From the identity sheet. 6.61:1 on near-black. Only 2.97:1 on white.

status-bad.comment: Fault, on LIGHT surfaces. 5.72:1 on white. STATUS ONLY, and rationed - a dashboard that is often red trains people to ignore red.

status-bad-dark.comment: Fault, ON DARK. From the identity sheet. 4.30:1 on near-black - acceptable for a pill with its word beside it, and it carries an icon and a label, never colour alone.

cool-gray.comment: Supporting neutral from the identity sheet - borders, dividers, light UI. 1.21:1 on white, so it is a SURFACE colour and never text.

ledger-nav.comment: Signal Ledger: midnight-ink navigation foundation, taken from the owner-selected concept (Image 1, 'Midnight'). ledger-nav-text is 15.67:1 on it; violet-bright 5.03:1.

ledger-nav-raised.comment: Signal Ledger: hover/active row on the navigation foundation. DERIVED from ledger-nav; ledger-nav-text is 13.56:1 on it.

ledger-nav-text.comment: Signal Ledger: primary text on ledger-nav. 15.67:1.

ledger-nav-muted.comment: Signal Ledger: secondary text on ledger-nav. 7.61:1. Never on a light surface.

ledger-paper.comment: Signal Ledger: the warm neutral management workspace. Body text ledger-text is 12.24:1 on it; ledger-muted 5.35:1; violet 6.10:1.

ledger-raised.comment: Signal Ledger: a raised surface on paper, used sparingly for genuinely discrete items. ledger-muted is 5.69:1 on it.

ledger-line.comment: Signal Ledger: the thin ledger hairline and section divider. A SURFACE colour, never text.

ledger-line-strong.comment: Signal Ledger: emphasised divider, control borders and chart axes. Never text.

ledger-text.comment: Signal Ledger: body text on paper. 12.24:1.

ledger-muted.comment: Signal Ledger: secondary text on paper. 5.35:1 on paper, 5.69:1 on raised.

verified.comment: Signal Ledger: muted cyan for VERIFIED monitoring coverage and available evidence. A graphic fill (coverage strips, evidence markers) at 3.32:1 on paper - never body text, never a health status (green stays the only healthy colour).

verified-text.comment: Signal Ledger: verified-coverage wording on paper. 5.84:1.

verified-soft.comment: Signal Ledger: quiet background behind verified-coverage figures. A SURFACE colour.

unknown.comment: Signal Ledger: 'could not be verified' / unknown graphic fill (cool slate, per the Signal Ledger palette), always hatched and always labelled. 3.22:1 on paper. Unknown is neutral grey - never green, never red, never zero.
